decisions.statement: The findings are read from the file the landing writes rather than composed.
The panel draws the rows that file has before any change to the file arrives.
The panel draws again when that file is written and at no other time.
A file written while the panel is hidden is kept rather than drawn.
A panel becoming visible with a drawing owed draws the rows the file last had.
The rows the file has are drawn unchanged rather than spelled again.
The panel counts the findings it holds rather than the rows it holds.
A finding naming no domain is named on the channel.
Nothing tells Alan of a finding naming no domain, since the row is drawn anyway.
No watcher on a source file is registered here.
Nothing here decides the look of a row.

definition: the Findings panel brought up, and the findings drawn into it from one file
